name: fast-agent
summary: CLI-first Python agent harness and framework with end-to-end MCP support (sampling, elicitation, OAuth), Agent Skills, ACP and declarative multi-agent workflows.
description: Run `uvx fast-agent-mcp@latest -x` for an interactive session with shell access, or install with `uv tool install -U fast-agent-mcp`. Connect MCP servers over stdio or Streamable HTTP with `/connect`, manage SKILL.md skills with `/skills`, and use any setup from an ACP client via `fast-agent-acp`. Supports Anthropic, OpenAI and Google natively plus many others (including llama.cpp and Ollama); agents can also be exposed as MCP servers. Includes Streamable HTTP transport diagnostics. PyPI `fast-agent-mcp` 0.10.47 (Python 3.12–3.15).
